results.title: CM Adityanath says 'Ramdrohi' will create confusion over Sanatan glory, calls for unity
results.description: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed a gathering at Gorakhnath temple on Ram temple construction. He emphasized the significance of unity among followers of Sanatan Dharma traditions and sects. Adityanath recalled the involvement of Mahant Digvijay Nath in the Ram Janmabhoomi movement and the strategy behind Ram Lalla's installation. He warned against those creating confusion regarding the glory of Lord Ram and Sanatan Dharma.

results.title: Malaysia sends 1,476 Myanmar nationals home despite UN warnings over safety
results.description: In a significant move, Malaysia has initiated a voluntary repatriation program for Myanmar nationals amidst safety concerns. The first batch of 1,476 individuals has commenced their return, with an additional 5,000 set to follow. Currently, 10,388 Myanmar nationals are detained in immigration facilities nationwide. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim is urging Myanmar to accept its citizens back and is planning discussions with leader Min Aung Hlaing to tackle refugee matters.
